notes.title: Starting Closed Alpha Playtests - Sign Up Now
notes.content:
[h1]Get Ready to Playtest Stormforge Next Week[/h1]

[previewyoutube=7FI_VP3_1KU;full][/previewyoutube]

Gather, Stormforged! 

If you haven’t already filled out the [url=https://playstormforge.typeform.com/to/kYzHsM3K]playtest form[/url], now is a great time to do so. We’re getting ready to run our first closed alpha playtest next week.

Be sure to provide your hardware specs by filling out the survey completely.

And don’t worry if you aren’t selected for this first test, we will be running many more closed alpha playtests throughout the year as we look to gather your feedback and iterate on the game.

[h1]What to Expect from the Playtest[/h1]
[url=https://playstormforge.typeform.com/to/kYzHsM3K][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048457/7f490bcc8750d7864646f36acba6acfe94db2298.gif[/img][/url]

Stormforge is still very much a work in progress. What you can expect:

[list]
[*] single player only (for now)
[*] one island to explore (boats coming soon)
[*] one mini-boss fight
[*] approximately 1 hour of gameplay (more if you are into building)
[*] core systems in place: foraging, crafting, combat, building, exploration
[/list]

If you are selected for the playtest, look for an email with instructions for how to join. Emails will go out early next week.

[url=https://playstormforge.typeform.com/to/kYzHsM3K][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048457/12a35b8157e9f6c9104e3873cf6cb33debaa9344.gif[/img][/url]

We can't wait to have you explore the world of Sorana and join us in making Stormforge the best it can be for you. 

The Roboto Games Team

notes.title: Upcoming survival game Stormforge is Valheim but with a creative twist
notes.content:
Stormforge wants to be a different kind of survival game. If you've played Enshrouded, Palworld, Ark, Valheim, and Rust you know what to expect on the surface, but beyond the comic book-style appearance, Stormforge has some incredibly unique ideas. Speaking to PCGN at Gamescom, developer Roboto Games outlines what you can expect, while diving into the cool modding tools planned for the upcoming game.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Introducing Stormforge, revealed at IGN Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048457/2d2436a3029c543141a2b2d77ef5912e51e2d7cc.png[/img]

From the storms, emerge!

We have been working diligently on our new project, and we’re thrilled to finally unveil it to you at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/IGN_live]IGN Live[/url], make sure to watch the show to see our new Reveal Trailer! Our new game is called Stormforge and it is coming to Early Access next year.

Stormforge is an open-world survival game that supports solo and co-op play for up to 8 players. Explore, forage, craft, build, and battle in a procedurally generated world being ravaged by dangerous magical storms. Establish your base, defeat epic bosses, and explore the different biomes of Sorana.

Sounds like your kind of adventure? Make sure to Wishlist and Follow Stormforge on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2826790/Stormforge/

We love to engage with and collect feedback from our community as we develop the game. The best place to connect with us is on our Discord server:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/playstormforge]Join our Discord[/url]

Also, if you want to be the first to playtest our game, make sure to join our Mailing List at https://www.playstormforge.com/


As we continue developing Stormforge, we will regularly seek your input.

If you like what you’ve seen, join us for the journey!
